Method of Attack: Compromised update servers to push malicious software update delivering Petya/NotPetya ransomware
Password harvesting to gather local network credentials
Use of PsExec and WMIC tools to spread within local network
Exploitation of NSA leaked exploits ETERNALBLUE and ETERNALROMANCE to spread via LAN
Impacted Systems: Ukrainian companies using M.E.Doc accounting software
Attack Vector: Malicious software update for M.E.Doc accounting software
Indicators of Compromise: Use of NSA exploits ETERNALBLUE and ETERNALROMANCE
Use of PsExec and WMIC tools
Ransomware identified as Petya, NotPetya, or Petna
